title: US residency and fellowship visa sponsorship data
description: What the websites of every open US residency and fellowship program say about J-1 and H-1B visas and about international medical graduates, counted nationally, by specialty and by state. Compiled by ResidencySpot from each program's own website with written rules; each fact keeps its source sentence. Live tables, method and limits: https://residencyspot.com/research/visa-sponsorship
